# shipd_audit_destination (Resource)

Manages one webhook, SIEM, or S3-compatible audit export destination. Destroy removes this destination. Use an organization-wide service-account token with organization:update and the audit log entitlement. Use shipd to view delivery history, send tests, and generate one-off exports.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "audit_webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "audit_siem_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

variable "audit_s3_secret_access_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "shipd_audit_destination" "webhook" {
  type               = "webhook"
  name               = "Audit webhook"
  url                = "https://receiver.example/audit"
  events             = ["flag.updated", "flag.created"]
  credential_version = "webhook-v1"
  credential_wo      = var.audit_webhook_secret
}

resource "shipd_audit_destination" "siem" {
  type               = "siem"
  name               = "Audit SIEM"
  url                = "https://siem.example/services/collector"
  format             = "splunk_hec"
  credential_version = "siem-v1"
  credential_wo      = var.audit_siem_token
}

resource "shipd_audit_destination" "s3" {
  type               = "s3"
  name               = "Audit archive"
  endpoint           = "https://s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  bucket             = "example-audit-archive"
  prefix             = "shipd"
  access_key_id      = "EXAMPLEACCESSKEYID"
  credential_version = "s3-v1"
  credential_wo      = var.audit_s3_secret_access_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name, 1 to 80 UTF-16 code units.
- `type` (String) Destination type. Choose webhook, siem, or s3. Changing the type replaces the destination.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) S3 access key ID. Terraform stores this identifier in plan and state as sensitive.
- `bucket` (String) Required for S3. Name of the bucket that receives audit events.
- `credential_version` (String) Nonsecret version of the credential. Set it for creation or change it to rotate the credential in place. Omit when adopting an existing credential through import.
- `credential_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Webhook signing secret (at least 16 characters), SIEM token, or S3 secret access key. Supply with credential_version on creation or rotation from an ephemeral input. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether shipd streams audit events to this destination. Defaults to true.
- `endpoint` (String, Sensitive) Required for S3. Use an absolute S3-compatible endpoint without credentials, a query, or a fragment. Terraform stores this URL in plan and state as sensitive.
- `events` (Set of String) Webhook audit actions to deliver. Omit to deliver all audit actions.
- `format` (String) Required for SIEM. Choose json, splunk_hec, datadog, axiom, or better_stack.
- `prefix` (String) Optional S3 object key prefix.
- `region` (String) Required for S3. Region used to sign requests.
- `url` (String, Sensitive) Required for webhook and SIEM. Use an absolute URL without credentials, a query, or a fragment. Terraform stores this URL in plan and state as sensitive.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable audit destination ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Omit credential_wo and credential_version when adopting the stored credential.
terraform import shipd_audit_destination.webhook 6ac71ef5-42d5-4a28-845a-e0df74ea2982
```
